scripts.prebuild: node scripts/validate-dynamic-css.js && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const distDir = path.join(__dirname, 'src/main/resources/META-INF/resources/dist'); try { fs.rmSync(distDir, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch(e) {}"
scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production npx postcss ./src/main/resources/css/index.css -o ./src/main/resources/META-INF/resources/dist/main.css && NODE_ENV=production node scripts/hash-css.js && NODE_ENV=production node scripts/hash-js.js
scripts.build:dev: NODE_ENV=development npx postcss ./src/main/resources/css/index.css -o ./src/main/resources/META-INF/resources/dist/main.css && NODE_ENV=development node scripts/hash-css.js && NODE_ENV=development node scripts/hash-js.js
scripts.preview: echo 'Preview not configured for CSS-only build'
